fullPassage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they will be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of them had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies for learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers... they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been passionate in some personal interest. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they read voraciously to find out more.

questions.passage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they will be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of them had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies for learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers... they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been __________. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they read voraciously to find out more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 passionate in some personal interest(어떤 개인적 관심사에 열정적인)가 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① passionate in some personal interest(어떤 개인적 관심사에 열정적인): Fink가 발견한 공통 패턴 ← 정답

❌ ② afraid of any new challenge(새로운 도전을 두려워하는): 본문 무관

❌ ③ poor at every single subject(모든 과목에 서툰): 본문과 어긋남

❌ ④ unable to read even one word(한 단어도 못 읽는): 본문과 반대
